name: Palmora
detailed_description:
Palmora

Palmora is a relaxing production and trading simulation game where you start with nothing and build your own business from the ground up. With no money in your pocket, your journey begins by collecting garbage from the streets and selling it to the recycling center. With your first earnings, you purchase a small workshop and begin your production journey.

Over time, you'll upgrade your capabilities, craft various products, package them, and sell them to Pacific Palm Mall, the city's major commercial hub. With your profits, you can upgrade to a larger workshop, unlock licenses to produce more valuable items, buy a house, and purchase vehicles to access different parts of the city.

Core Gameplay Features

Start From Nothing

  • Collect street trash and sell it to the recycling center

  • Buy your first small workshop and begin crafting basic items

  • Progress to a larger workshop with advanced production equipment

Craft and Package

  • Use materials like wood, paper, fabric, and metal to craft a variety of products

  • Package your items for delivery and send them to the mall

  • Earn income with every item you sell

Trade and Currency

  • Earn the city’s official currency, Palin, by selling products

  • Spend Palin to unlock licenses, upgrade your workshop, and buy vehicles or home decorations

  • Manage your economy and grow your business at your own pace

Collectible Card System

  • Purchase collectible card packs from card shops

  • Use the cards to trade for vehicles, food, or decorative items

  • Build themed sets across categories such as furniture, food, vehicles, and rare finds

Day-Night Cycle

  • Experience a dynamic day-night system

  • Work, explore, or rest as the city transitions from day to night

  • Enjoy the atmosphere of Palmora in changing light and mood

Expansion and Personalization

  • Buy from over 20 different vehicle types to boost mobility and delivery efficiency

  • Purchase your own home and customize it with various decorative elements

  • Unlock new product categories through the licensing system

Survival Balance

  • Monitor hunger and thirst levels

  • Stay energized and efficient by consuming food and drinks

  • Balance production with personal well-being

What Palmora Offers

  • A stress-free, player-driven simulation experience

  • A deep system combining crafting, packaging, selling, and collection mechanics

  • A collectible card economy that enhances gameplay through meaningful item trades

  • A living city with a real-time day-night cycle

  • A satisfying sense of progression—from picking up trash to becoming a master producer with your own home and workshop

short_description: From street scavenger to production tycoon, collect, craft, and trade your way to the top in the bustling city of Palmora. Build your empire with workshops, vehicles, licenses, and more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or equivalent (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
